title: ClickHouseIntegrationS3Fsxn
description: ClickHouse integration with FSx ONTAP file system.

fsxnId.description: AWS ID of the FSx ONTAP file system.

httpsEnabled.description: Whether HTTPS is enabled for communication with the FSxN S3 endpoint. Defaults to true when not specified.

vpcId.description: AWS VPC ID where the FSx ONTAP file system is located.

region.description: AWS region where the FSx ONTAP file system is located.

caCertificate.description: PEM-encoded root CA certificate for the FSxN SVM endpoint. Required when httpsEnabled is true.

providerAccountName.description: Provider account name where the FSx ONTAP file system is located. Not required when selfManagedNetwork is true.

selfManagedNetwork.description: When true, the customer manages all cross-account network connectivity (VPC peering, route tables, FSxN-side security group).

fsxnFilesystem.description: FSx ONTAP file system for the S3 FSxN integration.

namedCollection.description: A convenience named collection for query use.

id.description: ID of the S3 FSxN integration.

status.description: Status of the S3 FSxN Integration.
